title: Dispute Response Fee for Repeated Chargeback Disputes, Northloop Payments
content:
Northloop withholds a dispute response fee from Northloop Payments sellers who contest chargebacks repeatedly.

**Rule.** When the seller's dispute on a chargeback case is recorded as won, the debit returned on that case is the return basis less the dispute response fee, never below zero, rounded to the cent. The dispute response fee starts from a base response fee of 25.00 USD when the seller submitted at least 3 chargeback disputes in the last twelve months, counting the won one, 15.00 USD when the seller submitted exactly 2, and nothing when the won dispute is the only one.

A window of the last twelve months takes in the disputes submitted after the same calendar day twelve months before the return date, up to and including the return date.

## Base response fee by dispute count

| Chargeback disputes the seller submitted in the last twelve months, the won one included | Base response fee |
|---|---|
| 3 or more | 25.00 USD |
| exactly 2 | 15.00 USD |
| 1 (the won dispute only) | nothing |

Every dispute the seller submitted in the window counts, whatever its outcome.

## Hypothetical cases

- Two earlier disputes in the window, one lost and one still open, plus the won one: 3 disputes, base response fee 25.00 USD.
- One earlier dispute submitted thirteen months before the return date, plus the won one: the earlier dispute is outside the window, so the count is 1 and no dispute response fee arises.
- A return basis of 12.00 USD against a dispute response fee of 15.00 USD: the debit returned is never below zero, so it is 0.00 USD.
